_comment: The contract for ONE next-chapter option the planner proposes (STORYMAKER_AUTHORSHIP_PLAN.md AA.1; story/planner/PLANNER.md). story/tools/bible_check.py reads every rule from here and checks the option against the book's bible (a storymaker.getBible export). Domain-agnostic: an option for a history or a campaign uses the same shape with that book's people and numbers. DECODER SAFETY: comment keys at this TOP LEVEL ONLY.
_nearMissWhy: An unknown name close to a bible name (difflib ratio at or above nearMissCutoff) is reported with 'did you mean': most unknown names are misspellings.
_ruleWhy: ruleTested names a World Rules row by its Category or by its name: the Rule text up to its first full stop, as the designer writes rules ('The salt oath. Mechanism: …'). A leading word in this list is ignored on both sides. A word that is merely IN a rule ('oath') does not match: the planner names the rule it tests.
_keysWhy: A row is found by its table's key column (the same Name / Rule / Term the designer's seed rows use), or by an alias in an Aliases column.
_costWhy: An option that uses a row with a cost (a skill, a module, an implant) must say how the cost is paid this chapter. A gain with no cost is the most common way a progression story goes flat (designer arc.cost).
